#TrafficAlert: A truck carrying wheat overturned near Sector 135 during peak hours, causing massive jams on the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway. Traffic is moving via a single lane. Crane on site. 
Commuters are advised to avoid the route if possible.

[6:10AM]  #Ikeja
#Alausa
#TrafficUpdate

There's rapid movement on Lateef Jakande road from Omole roundabout through Wemco junction,  Cadbury, daily times down to Coca-Cola junction.

An appreciable movement as well on Obafemi Awolowo Way from Coca-Cola junction, Radio ,Allen junction , Balogun to Ikeja underneath the bridge.

Vehicular movement along Aromire inward Adeniyi through to Akko villa  is also still in good shape.

The entire stretch of Mobolaji Johnson Avenue is good from Old tollgate, 7up gate, BillingsWay to Alausa intersection, same as  Dr. Nurudeen Olowopopo to connect Otedola underneath the bridge.
